name: separate-generators
$comment: The same edge leak with one 10 l/min generator per cup: the leaking cup is lost, the five others keep their own vacuum.

parameters.name: cx
parameters.description: Centre of mass offset from the box centre, x

parameters.name: perm
parameters.description: Air permeance of the parcel (0 sealed, 4e-7 cardboard, 2e-6 porous)

parameters.name: px
parameters.description: Half spacing of the outer cup columns (gripper x)

parameters.name: py
parameters.description: Half spacing of the cup rows (gripper y)

parameters.name: A_lip0
parameters.description: Sealed-lip leak area per cup (surface roughness)

parameters.name: A_edge
parameters.description: Extra leak area of cup 1 (a cup over the parcel edge or a damaged lip)

parameters.name: s_bot
parameters.description: Bellows compression stroke before the folds bottom (estimate)

parameters.name: x_bot
parameters.description: Reference over-stroke of the bottoming law

parameters.name: A_fold
parameters.description: Folded bellows annulus: vacuum lift stroke A_fold*dp/k_ax (estimate)

parameters.name: c_vac
parameters.description: Lateral/tilt stiffness rise with vacuum, 1 + c_vac*dp/p_atm (estimate)

parameters.name: c_ext
parameters.description: Lateral/tilt stiffness fall with extension, exp(-c_ext*ext/L0) (estimate)

parameters.name: r_rev
parameters.description: Reverse area fraction of the cup line (1 = no check valve)

parameters.name: dp_close
parameters.description: Closing pressure drop of the per-cup flow valves (1e9 = none)

parameters.name: kind
parameters.description: Transfer profile: 1 trapezoidal, 2 S-curve, 3 polynomial 3-4-5, 4 cycloidal

parameters.name: lam
parameters.description: S-curve jerk phase / acceleration phase (0 < lam <= 0.5)

parameters.name: psi_deg
parameters.description: Yaw of the cup pattern relative to the path

parameters.name: k_tilt_g
parameters.description: Tilt gain (0 = level, 1 = cup axes along the specific force)

parameters.name: t_lead
parameters.description: Preview of the tilt command (the servo lag)

parameters.name: t_lift
parameters.description: Lift start (the vacuum is switched on at t = 0)

parameters.name: z0
parameters.description: Start height of the parcel centre of mass (resting on the table)

parameters.name: tcp_z
parameters.description: TCP (parcel centre of mass) z in the gripper frame

plots.title: Cup utilisation U (1 = pull-off, peel or slip)
Axial cup force T and holding force Fcap [N]
Parcel sway relative to the gripper [rad]
